terms.query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT ?term ?number ?seats ?period ?start ?end WHERE {
 GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/houses> { ?term a a:DailTerm; a:termNo ?number .
 OPTIONAL {?term a:seats ?seats} OPTIONAL {?term dct:temporal ?period . OPTIONAL {?period dcat:startDate ?start} OPTIONAL {?period dcat:endDate ?end}} }
} ORDER BY ?number ?term ?start ?end

sponsorship.query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT ?g ?member ?name ?bill ?title ?delivery ?process ?participation ?role ?activity ?date WHERE {
 GRAPH ?mg {?member a a:Member; foaf:name ?name . VALUES ?name {"Malcolm Byrne" "Ivana Bacik"}}
 FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?mg),"https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/member/"))
 GRAPH ?g {?delivery a a:BillDelivery; dl:created_a_realization_of ?bill; dl:forms_part_of ?process .
 ?bill a dl:DraftLegislationWork; dct:title ?title . FILTER(LANG(?title)="en")
 ?process a dl:LegislativeProcess; dl:had_participation ?participation . ?participation a dl:Participation; dl:had_participant_person ?member .
 OPTIONAL {?participation dl:participation_role ?role}
 OPTIONAL {?activity a dl:LegislativeActivity; dl:forms_part_of ?process; dl:had_activity_type a:Published . OPTIONAL {?activity dl:activity_date ?date}}}
 FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?g),"https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/bill/"))
} ORDER BY ?member ?bill ?participation ?activity ?date
